description: Hand the Check payment to the server once it is mined, by the Check id. The server reads it on-chain (the payer the charge names signed it, the network USDC reached the fee wallet, at least the price, after the charge, the mark) and reserves the hash for this Check only. 201 with check.status paid: the credit exists. analysis_payment_pending (409): not mined yet, call again in a few seconds. analysis_payment_rejected (400, details.reason): this transaction does not pay this Check. tx_already_used (409): the hash already paid something else. check_not_found (404): no Check has this id. Mined after the charge's 30 minutes it still credits by the price of now on the networks it covers (lateCharge true, check.paidNetworks may be fewer); check_charge_expired (409) only when it covers none. check_credit_limit (409) and payer_blocked (403) are checked again here; nothing is reserved, so the same hash reported later still counts. Repeating the same hash is safe; never pay again.

checkId.description: The Check id from check_charge (CHK-...). It is the capability of this Check: keep it, and keep it private.

txHash.description: The EVM transaction hash or the Solana signature.

name: check_report_payment
